properties.name: keyboard_increment
properties.comment: The step of a keyboard seam move, in logical units; 8 by default. A value outside 1 to 256 throws std::out_of_range and changes nothing.
prepare: throw std::out_of_range("DockSite keyboard increment must lie in 1 to 256");

properties.name: drag_threshold
properties.comment: The distance, in logical units along either axis, a caption press moves before it drags (owner decision DK-26, D5-1: 4, or a host's metric; no host reports one yet). A value outside 1 to 64 throws std::out_of_range and changes nothing.
prepare: throw std::out_of_range("DockSite drag threshold must lie in 1 to 64");

not_properties.name: document_area_maximized
not_properties.reason: run-time interaction state (Ctrl+Shift+F12 toggles it), as set_drop_down_open; set_document_area_maximized stays a method
